What is the maximum number of web pages MistralAI-User may visit for a single user request in Vibe, and is there a per-minute rate limit?

text: The user is asking about specific limits for MistralAI-User in Vibe: maximum web pages per request and per-minute rate limit. I need to search the documentation for this information. Let me check the documentation structure to find relevant sections about Vibe, web browsing, and rate limits.

content.text:
The maximum number of web pages MistralAI-User may visit for a single user request in Vibe is **3**.

There is no documented per-minute rate limit for web browsing in Vibe.

[Vibe Web Browsing](https://docs.mistral.ai/features/vibe#web-browsing)
